home.title: Hey, I'm Saurab
paragraphs: I'm a web developer who loves exploring how things work behind the scenes. I enjoy taking a rough idea, figuring out the details, and slowly building it into something real.
My time goes into writing code, experimenting with new tech, and learning by doing. I'm driven by curiosity and enjoy the constant process of improving my craft.
Away from the keyboard, you'll usually find me playing video games, cooking or brainstorming my next project.
Feel free to connect with me on [GitHub](https://github.com/41saurab) or [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/saurab-shrestha-30b705259)!

projects.title: Inkline
projects.details: A publishing platform where many authors write and categorise posts, and readers comment, like and bookmark. Built as a modular REST API where people can only edit their own content.

projects.title: Marketa
projects.details: A marketplace for customers, sellers and admins with a persistent cart, checkout with tax and service charges, order tracking, reviews and an admin dashboard.

projects.title: Threadly
projects.details: A messaging app with instant delivery, typing indicators and online presence. Chat history is saved across sessions and devices over secured WebSocket connections.

projects.title: ShortNPay
projects.details: A team project for shortening and sharing links without signing up, with fast redirects and Stripe payments for paid features.
